content: 1. A clinical trial compared the efficacy of entecavir versus placebo in children with chronic hepatitis B who were positive for the hepatitis B envelope antigen. The results were published in Hepatology in 2016 (Volume 63, Pages 377–387). 2. Jung YK, Yim HJ, Suh SJ, and colleagues conducted a study comparing the effectiveness of entecavir and tenofovir monotherapy in treatment-naïve patients with hepatitis B virus. This research was presented in Hepatology in 2016 (Volume 64, Supplement 1, Page 911A). 3. Liang RY, Xu JH, Si CW, Wang S, Shang J, Yu ZJ, and others performed a randomized, double-blind, double-dummy, controlled, multicenter study comparing Qingzhong (tenofovir disoproxil fumarate) and Viread for treating chronic hepatitis B. The first-stage results at week 48 were published in Medicine (Baltimore) in 2019 (Volume 98, Article e16778). 4. Liu Z, Jin Q, Zhang Y, Gong G, Wu G, Yao L, and colleagues evaluated 96 weeks of treatment with tenofovir amibufenamide and tenofovir disoproxil fumarate in patients with chronic hepatitis B. The findings were published in Journal of Clinical and Translational Hepatology in 2023 (Volume 11, Pages 649–660). 5. Xu JH, Wang S, Zhang DZ, Yu YY, Si CW, Zeng Z, and others reported on 192 weeks of treatment with entecavir maleate in Chinese patients with chronic hepatitis B, predominantly genotypes B or C. The study was published in World Journal of Clinical Cases in 2022 (Volume 10, Pages 10085–10096). 6. Wong WCW, Marley G, Li J, Yan W, Chan PL, Tucker JD, and colleagues conducted a randomized controlled trial to enhance viral hepatitis testing in primary care using a digital crowdsourced intervention. The results were published in NPJ Digital Medicine in 2022 (Volume 5, Article 95). 7. Flanagan S, Kunkel J, Appleby V, Eldridge SE, Ismail S, Moreea S, and others conducted the HepFREE trial, a cluster-randomized controlled trial focused on case finding and therapy for chronic viral hepatitis in primary care. The findings were published in The Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology in 2019 (Volume 4, Pages 32–44). 8. Nardone A, Nerlander L, Duffell E, Valenciano M, Buti M, Marcos-Fosch C, and colleagues piloted a sentinel surveillance system to monitor treatment and outcomes of chronic hepatitis B and C infections in clinical centers across three European countries in 2019. The study was published in Euro Surveillance in 2023 (Volume 28, Article 2200184). 9. Duah A and Nartey YA described the clinical profile and challenges in managing hepatitis B patients attending a district hospital clinic in Ghana. Their findings were published in International Journal of Hepatology in 2023 (Article 4424718). 10. Wang AE, Terrault NA, Fong TL, and Zhou K examined disparities in the presentation and management of chronic hepatitis B among Hispanic patients in a diverse safety-net system. The study was published in Hepatology Communications in 2023 (Volume 7, Article e008199). 11. Serper M, Choi G, Forde KA, and Kaplan DE conducted a national cohort study on care delivery and outcomes among U.S. veterans with hepatitis B. The results were published in Hepatology in 2016 (Volume 63, Pages 1774–1782). 12. Larkin M, Mahmood M, Ward J, Hummerston B, Johnson D, and Laurence C reported on the management of chronic hepatitis B in six South Australian Aboriginal community-controlled health services. The study was published in Australian Journal of Primary Health in 2022 (Volume 28, Pages 508–513). 13. Musabaev E, Estes C, Sadirova S, Bakieva S, Brigida K, Dunn R, and colleagues discussed the challenges of viral hepatitis elimination in lowand middle-income countries, focusing on the Uzbekistan Hepatitis Elimination Program (UHEP). The findings were published in Liver International in 2023 (Volume 43, Pages 773–784). 14. Heil J, Hoebe C, Cals JWL, Ter Waarbeek HLG, van Loo IHM, and Dukers-Muijrers N explored the detection of hepatitis B and C through combined public health and primary care birth cohort testing. The study was published in Annals of Family Medicine in 2018 (Volume 16, Pages 21–27). 15. Shiha G, Soliman R, Serwah A, Mikhail NNH, Asselah T, and Easterbrook P evaluated a same-day test and treat model for chronic hepatitis B and C infections in two community-based pilot studies in Egypt. The results were published in Journal of Viral Hepatitis in 2020 (Volume 27, Pages 593–601). 16. Abutaleb A, Khatun M, Clement J, Baidya A, Singh P, Datta S, and colleagues developed a care model optimized for marginalized remote populations, revealing migration patterns in India. The study was published in Hepatology in 2021 (Volume 73, Pages 1261–1274). 17. Sow A, Lemoine M, Toure PS, Diop M, Lo G, De Veiga J, and others reported on the HBV continuum of care using communityand hospital-based screening interventions in Senegal as part of the PROLIFICA program. The findings were published in JHEP Reports in 2022 (Volume 4, Article 100533). 18. Vinikoor MJ, Sinkala E, Kanunga A, Muchimba M, Zanolini A, Saag M, and colleagues assessed eligibility for hepatitis B antiviral therapy among adults in Zambia's general population. The study was published in PLOS One in 2020 (Volume 15, Article e0227041). 19. Lung KK, To WP, Mak LY, Fung J, Yuen MF, and Seto WK examined linkage to retention and treatment following territory-wide screening and care referral for chronic hepatitis B patients. The findings were published in Hepatology in 2022 (Volume 76, Supplement 1, Pages S1125–S1126). 20. Pham TND, Le DH, Dao DVB, Phan LTB, Pham TTT, Nguyen TB, and colleagues established a baseline framework for hepatitis B virus micro-elimination in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, through a community-based seroprevalence study. The study was published in The Lancet Regional Health – Western Pacific in 2023 (Volume 30, Article 100620). 21. Zheng H, Zhang G, Wang F, Yin Z, Miao N, Sun X, and others investigated self-motivated medical care-seeking behaviors and disease progression in a community-based cohort of chronic hepatitis B patients in China. The findings were published in BMC Public Health in 2019 (Volume 19, Article 901). 22. Wong RJ, Jain MK, Therapondos G, Niu B, Kshirsagar O, and Thamer M reported low rates of hepatitis B virus treatment among treatment-eligible patients in safety-net health systems. The study was published in Journal of Clinical Gastroenterology in 2022 (Volume 56, Pages 360–368). 23. Harris AM, Rwegasha J, Salim A, Said S, and McMahon B described the establishment of hepatitis B care and treatment clinics in Tanzania as a demonstration project following WHO guidelines. The findings were published in Journal of Viral Hepatitis in 2018 (Volume 25, Supplement 2, Page 155). 24. Katwaroe WK, Brakenhoff SM, van der Spek DPC, de Knegt RJ, van Kleef LA, de Man RA, and colleagues assessed adherence to clinical guidelines in patients with chronic hepatitis B. The study was published in Viruses in 2022 (Volume 14, Article 2229). 25. Wu Y, Johnson KB, Roccaro G, Lopez J, Zheng H, Muiru A, and others highlighted poor adherence to AASLD guidelines for chronic hepatitis B management and treatment in a large academic medical center. The findings were published in American Journal of Gastroenterology in 2014 (Volume 109, Pages 867–875). 26. Van Oorschot E, Koc ÖM, Oude Lashof AM, van Loo IH, Ackens R, Posthouwer D, and colleagues analyzed the cascade of care among hepatitis B patients in Maastricht, the Netherlands, from 1996 to 2018. The study was published in Journal of Virus Eradication in 2022 (Volume 8, Article 100075). 27. Lemoine M, Shimakawa Y, Njie R, Taal M, Ndow G, Chemin I, and others evaluated the acceptability and feasibility of a screen-and-treat program for hepatitis B virus infection in The Gambia as part of the PROLIFICA study. The findings were published in The Lancet Global Health in 2016 (Volume 4, Pages e559–e567). 28. Shanmugam RP, Balakrishnan S, Varadhan H, and Shanmugam V reported the prevalence of hepatitis B and C infections in a population-based study in southern India. The study was published in European Journal of Gastroenterology & Hepatology in 2018 (Volume 30, Pages 1344–1351). 29. Kanters S, Park JJ, Chan K, Socias ME, Ford N, Forrest J, and colleagues conducted a systematic review and network meta-analysis of interventions to improve adherence to antiretroviral therapy. The findings were published in The Lancet HIV in 2017 (Volume 4, Pages e31–e40). 30. Mbuagbaw L, Hajizadeh A, Wang A, Mertz D, Lawson DO, Smieja M, and others provided an overview of systematic reviews on strategies to improve treatment initiation, adherence to antiretroviral therapy, and retention in care for people living with HIV. The study was published in BMJ Open in 2020 (Volume 10, Article e034793). 31. Oru E, Trickey A, Shirali R, Kanters S, and Easterbrook P reviewed decentralization, integration, and task-shifting in hepatitis C virus infection testing and treatment globally. The findings were published in The Lancet Global Health in 2021 (Volume 9, Pages e431–e445). 32. The Polaris Observatory Collaborators modeled the global prevalence, cascade of care, and prophylaxis coverage of hepatitis B in 2022. The study was published in The Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology in 2023 (Volume 8, Pages 879–907). 33. Cui F, Blach S, Manzengo Mingiedi C, Gonzalez MA, Sabry Alaama A, Mozalevski A, and colleagues reported on global progress toward the elimination of hepatitis B and C in 2023. The findings were published in The Lancet Gastroenterology & Hepatology in 2023 (Volume 8, Pages 332–342).
